notes.title: Overhaul release date and new demo!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! 

Big news!

Overhaul will finally be released on October, 14th! 

And to make this release date official, we've released a launch trailer! Enjoy! 

Also, and for the second time, we participate in the Steam Fest, with a fresh and bigger-than-ever game demo, so you have something to nibble on waiting for the main dish! 


We hope you'll enjoy the demo. Wishlisting Overhaul is still the best way to support the game before the release. 
We've opened a discussion post for you to leave your feedback after experiencing the demo, you can also contact us on our social media, @BreadPandaGames.

Thanks for sticking with us!
